description: The GJ-36 RTO serves the Morbi district in Gujarat, known as the ceramic manufacturing hub of India. Established after the formation of Morbi as a separate district in 2013, it manages vehicle registrations and driving licenses for several key talukas in the region.
address: Old Toll Naka Building, Morbi - Miyana Bypass Road, Opp. Uma Resort, Morbi, Gujarat
